sources.shoulder_follow: Share of the upper arm's motion the deltoid group takes; 0.3 from the #15299 prototype (0, 0.3 and 0.6 differ little by eye).
sources.smoothing_iterations: Largest change of an edge length on the acromion path at 110 mm protraction: 34.0 mm with the stored weights, 16.6 mm after 5 passes, 12.7 mm after 15, 10.8 mm after 40 (2026-11-20). Fifteen takes most of the gain and leaves the rib cage alone.
sources.smoothing_radius_m: About one shoulder half-spacing (0.18 m on the tour-average subject): the girdle, not the sternum or the elbow.
sources.acromion: A 50 mm thick frontal strip through the shoulder joint, from 40 mm off the midline (outside the neck) to 100 mm beyond and below the joint (the sleeve cap); 105 edges, mean length 23 mm.
sources.step_limits_mm: Measured 5.6, 12.7 and 12.6 mm on the three girdle poses of tests/fixtures/model_appearance/girdle_poses.json, with margin for a subject of another size. A rigid mesh per body steps 45 to 113 mm on the same path.
sources.rigid_step_floor_mm: The criterion must tell the two apart: one body per vertex steps at least 45 mm on every pose.
